text: Introduced pure RavelError data for checked shape, slice, canonical-layout, rank, narrow, and permutation validation. Added narrowChecked and permuteAxesChecked for owned, borrowed, and mutable arrays; throwing conveniences wrap exact InvalidNarrow or PermutationError values in typed exceptions. Wrong permutation arity, invalid permutation axis, duplicate axis, and wrong-rank transpose now have distinct semantic errors. Audited every core Either left type: none inherits Throwable. Added ErrorContractSuite and updated failures/views/release docs. Evidence: sbt fmtCheck testAll representationProof docsCheck and sbt testAllFull passed; core JVM 175, core JS 171, browser 3/3, full JS links green; pre/post browser audits clean; git diff --check passed.
